label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.80 a.1…: The soul has an appetitive power related to what is…
locator: I q.80 a.1 co.; ad 1; ad 3
interpretation: The conclusion concerns a power by which an animal can appetitively relate to apprehended things, not an assertion that every intellectual capacity is currently exercised. Natural inclination itself is not identified with this cognition-relative appetite.
